title: Mechanical Components Functional Taxonomy
description: OWL 2 Functional-Style Syntax ontology classifying rotating machinery components, bearings, shafts, and gears with disjointness axioms.
code:
Prefix(: = <http://modelscript.org/ont/mech#>)
Prefix(owl: = <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>)
Prefix(xsd: = <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>)

Ontology(<http://modelscript.org/ont/mech>
  Declaration(Class(:MechanicalPart))
  Declaration(Class(:RotatingElement))
  Declaration(Class(:Shaft))
  Declaration(Class(:Gear))
  Declaration(Class(:Bearing))
  Declaration(Class(:BallBearing))
  Declaration(Class(:RollerBearing))
  Declaration(NamedIndividual(:mainDriveShaft))
  Declaration(NamedIndividual(:pinionGear01))

  SubClassOf(:RotatingElement :MechanicalPart)
  SubClassOf(:Shaft :RotatingElement)
  SubClassOf(:Gear :RotatingElement)
  SubClassOf(:Bearing :MechanicalPart)
  SubClassOf(:BallBearing :Bearing)
  SubClassOf(:RollerBearing :Bearing)

  DisjointClasses(:Shaft :Gear :Bearing)
  DisjointClasses(:BallBearing :RollerBearing)

  ClassAssertion(:Shaft :mainDriveShaft)
  ClassAssertion(:Gear :pinionGear01)
)

title: Process Plant P&ID Restrictions & Inverse Roles
description: OWL 2 Functional-Style ontology encoding chemical process P&ID equipment connectivity, existential restrictions, and inverse upstream/downstream flow roles.
code:
Prefix(: = <http://modelscript.org/ont/pid#>)
Prefix(owl: = <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>)
Prefix(xsd: = <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>)

Ontology(<http://modelscript.org/ont/pid>
  Declaration(Class(:ProcessEquipment))
  Declaration(Class(:Pump))
  Declaration(Class(:HeatExchanger))
  Declaration(Class(:ReactorVessel))
  Declaration(Class(:ControlValve))
  Declaration(Class(:FluidStream))
  Declaration(ObjectProperty(:feedsStream))
  Declaration(ObjectProperty(:fedByEquipment))
  Declaration(ObjectProperty(:hasControlValve))
  Declaration(DataProperty(:designPressureBar))
  Declaration(NamedIndividual(:P101))
  Declaration(NamedIndividual(:E201))
  Declaration(NamedIndividual(:R301))
  Declaration(NamedIndividual(:FV101))
  Declaration(NamedIndividual(:S10))

  SubClassOf(:Pump :ProcessEquipment)
  SubClassOf(:HeatExchanger :ProcessEquipment)
  SubClassOf(:ReactorVessel :ProcessEquipment)
  SubClassOf(:ControlValve :ProcessEquipment)

  InverseObjectProperties(:feedsStream :fedByEquipment)
  ObjectPropertyDomain(:feedsStream :ProcessEquipment)
  ObjectPropertyRange(:feedsStream :FluidStream)
  DataPropertyDomain(:designPressureBar :ProcessEquipment)
  DataPropertyRange(:designPressureBar xsd:double)

  SubClassOf(:Pump ObjectSomeValuesFrom(:feedsStream :FluidStream))
  SubClassOf(:ReactorVessel ObjectSomeValuesFrom(:hasControlValve :ControlValve))

  ClassAssertion(:Pump :P101)
  ClassAssertion(:HeatExchanger :E201)
  ClassAssertion(:ReactorVessel :R301)
  ClassAssertion(:ControlValve :FV101)
  ClassAssertion(:FluidStream :S10)
  ObjectPropertyAssertion(:feedsStream :P101 :S10)
  ObjectPropertyAssertion(:hasControlValve :R301 :FV101)
  DataPropertyAssertion(:designPressureBar :R301 "24.5"^^xsd:double)
)

title: Aerospace Avionics Ontology with Units Module
description: Multi-file OWL 2 ontology pairing an aerospace avionics subsystem taxonomy with a companion SI physical units ontology module.
code:
Prefix(: = <http://modelscript.org/ont/avionics#>)
Prefix(u: = <http://modelscript.org/ont/units#>)
Prefix(owl: = <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>)
Prefix(xsd: = <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>)

Ontology(<http://modelscript.org/ont/avionics>
  Declaration(Class(:AvionicsLRU))
  Declaration(Class(:FlightControlComputer))
  Declaration(Class(:InertialReferenceUnit))
  Declaration(Class(:AirDataComputer))
  Declaration(Class(:BusInterface))
  Declaration(Class(:ARINC429Bus))
  Declaration(ObjectProperty(:communicatesOver))
  Declaration(ObjectProperty(:requiresRedundancyFrom))
  Declaration(DataProperty(:dalLevel))
  Declaration(DataProperty(:busVoltageV))
  Declaration(NamedIndividual(:FCC_A))
  Declaration(NamedIndividual(:FCC_B))
  Declaration(NamedIndividual(:IRU_1))
  Declaration(NamedIndividual(:Bus_429_Primary))

  SubClassOf(:FlightControlComputer :AvionicsLRU)
  SubClassOf(:InertialReferenceUnit :AvionicsLRU)
  SubClassOf(:AirDataComputer :AvionicsLRU)
  SubClassOf(:ARINC429Bus :BusInterface)
  DisjointClasses(:FlightControlComputer :InertialReferenceUnit :AirDataComputer)

  ObjectPropertyDomain(:communicatesOver :AvionicsLRU)
  ObjectPropertyRange(:communicatesOver :BusInterface)
  SymmetricObjectProperty(:requiresRedundancyFrom)

  SubClassOf(:FlightControlComputer ObjectSomeValuesFrom(:communicatesOver :ARINC429Bus))

  ClassAssertion(:FlightControlComputer :FCC_A)
  ClassAssertion(:FlightControlComputer :FCC_B)
  ClassAssertion(:InertialReferenceUnit :IRU_1)
  ClassAssertion(:ARINC429Bus :Bus_429_Primary)
  ObjectPropertyAssertion(:communicatesOver :FCC_A :Bus_429_Primary)
  ObjectPropertyAssertion(:requiresRedundancyFrom :FCC_A :FCC_B)
  DataPropertyAssertion(:dalLevel :FCC_A "DAL-A"^^xsd:string)
  DataPropertyAssertion(:busVoltageV :FCC_A "28.0"^^xsd:double)
)

title: Digital-Twin Fault Reasoning Knowledge Base
description: Multi-file OWL 2 EL++ fault-diagnosis knowledge base combining an industrial plant ontology, Turtle sensor telemetry assertions, and a SPARQL fault query.
code:
Prefix(: = <http://modelscript.org/ont/faults#>)
Prefix(owl: = <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>)
Prefix(xsd: = <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>)

Ontology(<http://modelscript.org/ont/faults>
  Declaration(Class(:Asset))
  Declaration(Class(:Compressor))
  Declaration(Class(:Sensor))
  Declaration(Class(:VibrationSensor))
  Declaration(Class(:TemperatureSensor))
  Declaration(Class(:Anomaly))
  Declaration(Class(:BearingWearFault))
  Declaration(Class(:OverheatFault))
  Declaration(Class(:CriticalAsset))
  Declaration(ObjectProperty(:monitoredBy))
  Declaration(ObjectProperty(:exhibitsAnomaly))
  Declaration(DataProperty(:rmsVelocityMmS))
  Declaration(NamedIndividual(:Comp_01))
  Declaration(NamedIndividual(:Vib_01))
  Declaration(NamedIndividual(:Fault_Brg_01))

  SubClassOf(:Compressor :Asset)
  SubClassOf(:VibrationSensor :Sensor)
  SubClassOf(:TemperatureSensor :Sensor)
  SubClassOf(:BearingWearFault :Anomaly)
  SubClassOf(:OverheatFault :Anomaly)
  SubClassOf(:CriticalAsset :Asset)

  SubClassOf(ObjectIntersectionOf(:Compressor ObjectSomeValuesFrom(:exhibitsAnomaly :BearingWearFault)) :CriticalAsset)

  ObjectPropertyDomain(:monitoredBy :Asset)
  ObjectPropertyRange(:monitoredBy :Sensor)
  ObjectPropertyDomain(:exhibitsAnomaly :Asset)
  ObjectPropertyRange(:exhibitsAnomaly :Anomaly)

  ClassAssertion(:Compressor :Comp_01)
  ClassAssertion(:VibrationSensor :Vib_01)
  ClassAssertion(:BearingWearFault :Fault_Brg_01)
  ObjectPropertyAssertion(:monitoredBy :Comp_01 :Vib_01)
  ObjectPropertyAssertion(:exhibitsAnomaly :Comp_01 :Fault_Brg_01)
  DataPropertyAssertion(:rmsVelocityMmS :Vib_01 "11.4"^^xsd:double)
)

files.fault_query.rq:
PREFIX : <http://modelscript.org/ont/faults#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>

SELECT ?asset ?anomaly ?sensor
WHERE {
  ?asset :exhibitsAnomaly ?anomaly .
  ?asset :monitoredBy ?sensor .
}
ORDER BY ?asset
